overallNotes: Park Jae-hyun (personal_15) is a 33-year-old dispatch manager at Daejin Coastal Logistics in Busan, South Korea. His arc spans over three years (Jan 2025 to Apr 2028), documenting a gradual transformation from feeling stuck in operational chaos to systematically building a company-wide dispatch reliability system. Key themes: handoff documentation reform, marriage under shift-work strain, family financial support obligations, health deterioration and recovery from reflux/shift-work strain, and the maturation of personal preferences around leisure, food, travel, and music. The metadata had systemic issues: nearly all focus fields truncated at 50-60 chars, all summaries were first-turn quote fragments instead of narrative condensations, tags were generic single-word categories rather than specific descriptors, and emotional_tone was uniformly 'neutral' despite clearly varied emotional content. Every slice has been corrected.
